application: Never build a base by accepting the reviewers' revisions; they remain tracked in the deliverable.
preuve: rev1 and v8.0.0 (D3/D8) had accepted all the reviewers' revisions; F310.
regle: Colleague A, Colleague B, Colleague C and the guests have the authority to flag; their direct edits are suggestions subject to the same check and are never accepted in bulk; each receives a verdict (retained, adjusted, not retained, author's decision).
